name: cordis-plugin-novelist
description: File-ledger domain tools for long-form fiction production on DSH (deepseek-harness): 12 deterministic novel_* tools over a plain-file book ledger (project/bible/characters/foreshadows/timeline/outline/manuscript/status/events + editorial event-tape + scores.jsonl with evidence substring verification). v7.0 three semantic primitives: novel_ask (one-shot semantic ledger query with provenance), novel_chapter derive mode (in-chapter decision tape append + status advance + txn receipt), novel_decide (ruling-as-a-sentence: ledger effects + dual logging) — code does the accounting, the model does the writing.
